name: Warrior of the Elements (Monk Subclass - 2024)
description: Warrior of the Elements Monks punch with elemental fury, gaining reach, elemental damage types, area attacks, and eventually flight and resistances.
source: RPGBOT 2024 Warrior of the Elements Monk Subclass Guide (PHB)

3.name: Elemental Attunement
3.description: For 1 Focus Point (free action at start of turn), for 10 minutes: Unarmed strikes gain +10ft reach. Unarmed strikes can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (chosen per attack). When dealing elemental damage with an unarmed strike, can push or pull target 10ft.

6.name: Elemental Burst
6.description: As an action, spend 2 Focus Points. Creatures in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on you make a Dex save (vs. your Monk save DC). Take damage equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failed save, or half on success. Damage type is your choice from Elemental Strikes list (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder).

11.name: Stride of the Elements
11.description: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you gain a flying speed equal to your Unarmored Movement bonus.

17.name: Elemental Epitome
17.description: While Elemental Attunement is active: Gain Resistance to one type from Elemental Strikes (chosen at start of each turn, lasts till start of next). Destructive Stride: When using Step of the Wind, each creature you move adjacent to takes elemental damage (your choice) = one Martial Arts die roll. Empowered Strikes: Once per turn, when hitting with an elemental unarmed strike, add one Martial Arts die to damage.
